channel.title: The Hockey News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Hockey News (thehockeynews.com)

item.title: 'Underdog' Slovakia Punch Ticket To Semifinal At Olympics: 'We Came Out Flying'
item.description: Slovakia will play two more games in pursuit of a second straight podium finish in Olympic men's hockey. But are they underdogs? That depends on who you ask on the team.

item.title: NHL Rumor Roundup: Could The Kings Pursue Elias Pettersson? Which Blackhawks Could Be Traded?
item.description: Kevin Fiala's season-ending injury has one pundit wondering if they might be interested in Vancouver Canucks center Elias Pettersson. Meanwhile, the Blackhawks could attempt to peddle their UFA-eligible players at the trade deadline.

item.title: Canada's Sidney Crosby Goes To The Dressing Room After Taking Hit From Czechia's Radko Gudas
item.description: Canada captain Sidney Crosby left the bench during the second period.

item.title: NHL Sour Rankings: Vancouver Canucks Lead The Worst At Olympic Break
item.description: What ugly stat sticks out for each of the NHL's bottom six teams? And what's a reason for hope moving forward?

item.title: Mitch Marner Has The 'It' Factor For Canada When They Needed It Most Yet Again
item.description: Team Canada's Olympic campaign was one goal away from ending in the quarterfinals against Czechia. Mitch Marner, who was criticized with the Maple Leafs for failing to rise up to the occasion, met the moment again for the national team.

item.title: Are The Olympics Missing The NHL's Best Player Right Now?
item.description: Nikita Kucherov leads the NHL in points since Dec. 22, with 14 more points than second place? Could he win the Hart Trophy after the Olympic break, and is he the best player in the world at the moment? Gary Pearson takes a look for BetMGM.

item.title: 'He's A Gamer': Canada's Jordan Binnington Came Through As A Nation Held Its Breath
item.description: Set aside his stats with the St. Louis Blues – Jordan Binnington's play in net has been a different story altogether for Team Canada.

item.title: Screen Shots: Finland's Rollercoaster Olympics, Too Many Men Vs. Canada, Gold Medal Game Start Time
item.description: Adam Proteau discusses Team Finland's comeback win, an on-ice infraction the officials completely missed, and complaints about the start time of the men's gold medal game.

item.title: The Hockey News Big Show Live At The Games: Reacting To Dramatic Olympic Quarterfinals
item.description: Join the chat as Ryan Kennedy, Andrew McInnis and Michael Augello go live to recap the men's hockey Olympic quarterfinals, where Canada, Team USA, Slovakia and Finland moved on.

item.title: 'We Came Here For The Big One': Connor Hellebuyck, USA Eliminate Gold Medal Contenders
item.description: Connor Hellebuyck's been criticized in the past for his play in the Stanley Cup playoffs and other big moments. In a very tight matchup against Sweden at the Olympics, he flipped the script.
